description: Traffic Counts at Permanent stations is a dataset listed in City of Calgary open data portal (data.calgary.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Calgary. Permanent counts stations are used in trend analysis of traffic patterns around the city. The stations allow us to create seasonal and weekly variations for traffic data so that we can normalize any portable studies that are of short duration. Coverage: Calgary. The portal files it under the category Transportation/Transit. Its tags are volumes, car, counts, traffic, vehicle. The table has 7 columns. Attribution on the portal: The City of Calgary. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-calgary-ca-portal.
